text: トキワ　ジムの　リーダーが　かえって　きたぞ！

structure.jp: トキワ　ジムの　リーダーが

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form shows the action moving toward where the speaker is. かえって　きた = 'came back (here)'

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push news at the listener, like 'I tell you!'. きたぞ = 'he's come, I tell you!'
